name: LatentFormat process_in / process_out (model space scaling)
plain: The scale between VAE space and model space. Base formats only scale. SD3/Flux also shift, Playground 2.5 uses per-channel mean and std. This is what "normalize" nodes such as the EmberFrame one reverse by hand.
math:
base: in = x·k, out = x/k (SD15 k=0.18215, SDXL 0.13025)
SD3/Flux: in=(x−shift)·k, out=x/k+shift (Flux k=0.3611)
Playground: in=(x−μ)·k/σ, out=x·σ/k+μ

providers.author: emberframe
providers.note: manual (x−shift)·scale and inverse with Flux defaults 0.3611 and 0.1159, nodes.py:520
